comment.content: When multiple checkpoints reuse the same evidence ID with conflicting comment bodies, this branch only emits an observation and leaves `ambiguous` false. `--comment` therefore still returns the captured code span and aggregates all checkpoint claims as if the evidence were usable. Mark conflicting checkpoint claims ambiguous (and reject the detail view), while retaining ordinary checkpoint snapshots that match the captured comment.
